m: नि-√ रुध् P. tri॰ ni + ruDa--karmaRi kta । 1 saMrudDaM kftagamanAdipratiroDe “yatnanirudDavAhEH” mAGaH । pAta॰ BA॰ ukte 3 cittasyAvasTArUpaBUmiBede tacca tatroktaM yaTA “kziptaM mUdaM vikziptamekAgraM nirudDamiti cittamamayaH । tatra vikzipte cetasi vikzepopasarjanIBUtaH samADirna yogapakze varttate yastvekAgre cetasi sadBUtamarTaM pradyotayati kziRoti ca kleSAn karmabanDanAni SlaTayati niroDamaBimuKaM karoti sa samprajYAto yoga ityAKyAyate” vA॰ “kziptaM sadEva rajasA tezu tezu vizayezu kzipyamARamatyantamasTiram । mUQantu tamaHsamudrekAnnidrAvfttimat । vikziptaM kziptAdviSizwaM viSezo hi sTemavahulasya kAdAditkaH sTe mA sA cAsyA sTemabahulatA sAMsidDikI vA vakzyamARavyADistyAnAdyantarAyajanitA vA । ekAgramekatAnam । nirudDasakalavfttikaM saMskAramAtraSezaM cittaM nirudDam । tatra kziptamUQayoH satyapi parasparApekzayA vfttiniroDe pArampraryeRApi niSceyahetuBAvA'BAvAt tadupaGAtakatvAcca yogapakzAddUrotsAritatvamiti nataToryogatvaM nizidDam । vikziptasya tu kAdAcitka sadBUtavizayasTemaSAlinaH samBAvyeta yogatvAmiti nizeDati tatra vikzipte cetasi samADiH kAdAcitkaH sadBUtavizayasya cittasya sTemA na yogapakze varttake । kasmAdyatastadvipakzavikzepopasarjanIBUtaH vipakzavargAntargatasya hi svarUpameva durlaBaM prAgeva kAyakaraRAt । na Kalu dahanAntargataM vIjaM tricaturakzaRAvasTitamuptamapyaNkurAya kalpate iti BAvaH । yadi vikzepopasarjanIBUtaH samADirna yogaH kastarhi ityata Aha yastvekAgre cetasi iti । BUtamiti samAropitamarTaM nivarttayati । nidrAvfttirapi svAlambane tasasi BUte BavatyekAgretyata uktam saditi । SoBanaM nitAntamAvirBUtatattvaM, tamaHsamudrekastvaSoBanastasya kleSahetutvAditi । dyotanaM hi tattvajYAnamAgamAdvA'numAnAdvA Bavadapi parokzarUpatayA na sAkzAtkAravatImavidyAmucCinatti dvicandradiNmohAdizvanucCedakatvAdata Aha preti praSabdo hi prakarzaM dyotayan sAkzAtkAraM sUcayati । avidyAmUlatvAdasmitAdInAM kleSAnAM vidyAyASca avidyAcCedarUpatvAt vidyodaye cAvidyAkleSasamucCedo viroDitvAt kAraRa vinASAccetyAha kziRoti ceti । ataeva karmma rUpARi vanDanAni SlaTayati । karma cAtrApUrvamaBimataM kArye kAraRatvopacArAt । SlaTayati svakAryyAdavasAdayati । vakzyati hi “sati mUle tadvipAkaH” । iti kiYca niroDamaBimuKaM karotTaBimuKIkaroti” viva॰

a: निरुक्त — a. 1 Expressed, pronounced, explained, defined. --2 Loud, distinct. --क्तं 1 Explanation, derivation, etymological interpretation. --2 N. of one of the six Vedāṅgas, that which contains glossarial explanation of obscure words, especially those occurring in the Vedas; नाम च धातुजमाह निरुक्ते Nir. --3 N. of a celebrated commentary on the Nighaṇṭus by Yāska. --Comp. --कारः N. of the sage Yāska. --जः one of the twelve kinds of sons allowed by the old Hindu law (= क्षेत्रज q. v.).
